chapters.title: 1. 아버지를 아버지라 부르지 못하고
chapters.text:
조선 세종 때, 대대로 이름난 집안 출신인 홍 판서가 살았다. 그는 젊은 나이에 과거 시험에 합격한 뒤 높은 벼슬에 올랐다. 나라에 충성하고 부모에게 효도하는 사람으로 알려져 조정 안팎에서 존경을 받았다. 그에게는 두 아들이 있었다. 아내인 유 부인에게서 태어난 아들은 홍인형이었고, 집안에서 일하던 춘섬에게서 태어난 아들은 홍길동이었다.

길동이 태어나기 전, 홍 판서는 이상한 꿈을 꾸었다. 갑자기 천둥이 크게 울리더니 푸른 용이 수염을 세우고 그를 향해 달려들었다. 놀라서 눈을 뜨고 보니 꿈이었다. 그러나 홍 판서는 두려워하기는커녕 크게 기뻐했다.

‘용이 나오는 꿈을 꾸었으니, 분명 귀한 자식을 얻겠구나.’

그는 곧 유 부인이 있는 방으로 들어갔다. 부인이 일어나 맞이하자, 홍 판서는 반가운 마음에 손을 잡으며 가까이하려 했다. 하지만 유 부인은 표정을 굳히고 말했다.

“높은 지위에 계신 분이 어찌 경솔한 젊은이처럼 행동하십니까? 저는 따르지 않겠습니다.”

유 부인은 그의 손을 뿌리치고 나갔다. 홍 판서는 무안한 데다가 화까지 나서 밖으로 나왔다. 아내가 자신의 뜻을 이해하지 못한다고 여기며 불평하던 중, 마침 춘섬이 차를 가져왔다. 그는 주위가 조용한 것을 보고 춘섬을 작은 방으로 데려가 관계를 맺었다.

당시 춘섬은 열여덟 살이었다. 그 뒤로 춘섬은 다른 사람과 혼인할 생각 없이 지냈다. 홍 판서는 이를 기특하게 여겨 춘섬을 첩으로 삼았다. 정식 아내인 유 부인 외에 춘섬과도 부부 관계를 맺은 것이다. 춘섬은 그달부터 아이를 가졌고, 열 달 뒤 아들을 낳았다. 아이는 몸과 생김새부터 남달라 큰 인물이 될 듯했다. 홍 판서는 기뻐하면서도 그 아이가 유 부인에게서 태어나지 않은 것을 아쉬워했다.

길동은 자라면서 뛰어난 재능을 보였다. 여덟 살 무렵에는 하나를 들으면 여러 가지를 깨달을 만큼 영리했다. 홍 판서도 그런 길동을 더욱 사랑했다. 그러나 아버지의 사랑이 길동의 신분까지 바꾸어 주지는 못했다. 어머니가 신분이 낮은 집안 일꾼이었다는 이유로, 길동은 아버지를 ‘아버지’라 부르거나 형 인형을 ‘형’이라 부를 때마다 꾸지람을 들었다.

열 살이 넘어서도 길동은 그 두 말을 마음 놓고 입에 올릴 수 없었다. 집안에서 일하는 사람들조차 그를 업신여겼다. 그때마다 깊은 원한이 쌓여 마음을 가라앉히기 어려웠다.

어느 가을밤, 밝은 달이 뜨고 서늘한 바람이 불었다. 글을 읽던 길동은 문득 책상을 밀쳐 놓고 한숨을 쉬었다.

“세상에 태어났으니 학문으로 큰 뜻을 이루고 싶다. 그것이 어렵다면 군사를 이끄는 법을 배워 장수가 되겠다. 나라를 위해 큰 공을 세우고 오래도록 이름을 남긴다면 얼마나 보람 있겠는가. 그런데 나는 아버지와 형이 있는데도 아버지를 아버지라, 형을 형이라 부르지 못하는구나. 이렇게 외롭게 살아야 하니 가슴이 터질 것만 같다.”

말을 마친 길동은 뜰로 내려가 칼 쓰는 법을 연습했다. 마침 달빛을 구경하던 홍 판서가 그를 발견하고 불렀다.

“무슨 일이 있기에 밤이 깊도록 잠을 자지 않느냐?”

길동은 공손히 대답했다.

“달빛이 좋아 나와 있었습니다. 그런데 하늘이 만든 많은 것 가운데 사람이 가장 귀하다고 하지 않습니까? 저는 그런 귀한 대접을 받지 못하니, 어찌 저를 사람이라 할 수 있겠습니까?”

홍 판서는 길동이 무엇을 말하려는지 짐작했다. 그럼에도 일부러 모르는 척하며 나무라듯 물었다.

“그게 무슨 말이냐?”

길동은 다시 절을 하고 말했다.

“저를 낳고 길러 주신 부모님의 은혜는 깊습니다. 하지만 제게는 늘 서러운 일이 있습니다. 제 아버지를 아버지라 부르지 못하고, 제 형을 형이라 부르지 못합니다. 제 가족 앞에서조차 그러지 못하는데, 어찌 사람답게 산다고 할 수 있겠습니까?”

길동의 눈물이 흘러 옷을 적셨다. 홍 판서도 아들이 가엾었다. 그러나 그 마음을 달래 주었다가는 길동이 제 신분을 잊고 함부로 행동할까 두려웠다. 그는 위로하는 대신 큰 소리로 꾸짖었다.

“높은 벼슬을 하는 집안에서 신분 낮은 여자의 아들로 태어난 사람이 너뿐인 줄 아느냐? 그런데 어찌 이토록 건방지게 구느냐? 다시 이런 말을 하면 내 앞에 나타나는 것도 허락하지 않겠다.”

길동은 감히 대꾸하지 못한 채 엎드려 눈물만 흘렸다. 홍 판서가 물러가라고 명하자 자기 방으로 돌아왔지만, 슬픔은 좀처럼 가시지 않았다.

길동은 본래 재주가 뛰어날뿐더러 마음도 넓었다. 그러나 이 일로 마음을 진정하지 못해 밤마다 잠을 이루지 못하곤 했다. 그러던 어느 날, 어머니 춘섬의 방을 찾아가 울며 말했다.

“어머니와 제가 모자로 만난 인연은 깊습니다. 저를 길러 주신 은혜도 잊을 수 없습니다. 하지만 신분이 낮다는 이유로 남에게 업신여김을 받으며 살아가는 것은 더 이상 견디기 어렵습니다. 마음속에 쌓인 한을 억누를 수 없어 이제 어머니 곁을 떠나려 합니다. 저를 걱정하지 마시고 몸을 잘 돌보십시오.”

춘섬은 깜짝 놀라 아들을 말렸다.

“너와 같은 처지에 있는 사람이 너뿐이냐? 어찌 그렇게 좁은 마음을 먹고 어미의 가슴을 태우느냐?”

그러나 길동의 뜻은 바뀌지 않았다.

“저는 이곳을 떠나 제 길을 찾으려 합니다. 마음 놓으시고 제가 앞으로 어떻게 살아가는지 지켜봐 주십시오.”

길동은 이어 집안에서 느낀 위험을 이야기했다.

“요즘 홍 판서께서 아끼시는 다른 첩의 태도를 보니, 그분의 사랑을 잃을까 두려워 저와 어머니를 원수처럼 여기는 듯합니다. 이러다가는 저희가 큰 화를 입을까 걱정됩니다. 그러니 제가 나가는 일을 너무 염려하지 마십시오.”

아들의 말을 들은 춘섬도 슬픔을 떨칠 수 없었다.

Introduces Gildong's reaction as the narrative topic.

Closes the written narrative description.
로 marks this incident as the cause of his distress.

Recalls the ongoing situation before introducing a particular day.
Identifies the room as Chunseom's.

Respectfully states that their bond is deep.
Marks Gildong as the person his mother raised.

Marks low social status as the stated reason for contemptuous treatment.
With 받다, 에게 marks the people from whom the treatment comes.
Nominalizes looking down on someone so that it can denote the treatment received.
Marks contemptuous treatment as what he receives.
Receiving contemptuous treatment accompanies his continuing life.
Makes living under this treatment modify 것.
The modifier and 것 present living as an activity evaluated by the following predicate.
Makes living under contemptuous treatment the topic.

더 이상 specifies that continuing to endure the treatment is difficult.

Describes sorrow and resentment as having accumulated.
Marks his unresolved sorrow and resentment as what he cannot suppress.

grammar_links.context_en: States his intention respectfully to his mother.
저를 marks Gildong as the person his mother should not worry about.
-지 connects 걱정하다 to 말다, which prohibits worrying.
Gildong respectfully asks his mother not to worry about him; -고 connects this prohibition to the next request.
-시- respectfully addresses Gildong's mother as the person asked to refrain.
Connects the request not to worry with the request to take care of herself.
몸을 identifies what she should care for: her own body and health.
The honorific marker shows respect toward his mother.
A formal, respectful request that his mother take care of herself.
Introduces Chunseom's reaction to her son's announcement.
Written -아 links her sudden surprise to her subsequent attempt to stop him. The final past predicate places both actions in the past.
Her son is the person she tries to dissuade.
Places Chunseom's attempt to stop her son in the past.
Ends a statement in the chapter's plain written narrative register.
grammar_links.display_meaning_en: tried to stop him from leaving

grammar_links.context_en: 너와 gives the comparison partner for 같은: a situation like Gildong's.
같은 modifies 처지, describing a situation the same as his.
처지에 marks the situation occupied by the people described.
있는 modifies 사람이: people who are in that situation. 있다 here denotes being situated in a condition.
사람이 is the subject of the question asking whether Gildong alone belongs to this group.
뿐 restricts the group to Gildong alone; the rhetorical question rejects that restriction.
The copula makes 너뿐 into a predicate meaning that he is the only one.
Chunseom asks her son a familiar rhetorical question: others share his predicament.
그렇게 describes the degree or manner of the narrow outlook she criticizes.
좁은 modifies 마음 figuratively, describing a limited or narrow outlook.
마음을 is the object within 마음을 먹다, meaning to adopt an intention or mindset.
Connects adopting the narrow mindset to causing his mother anguish. 마음을 먹다 is figurative here, rather than eating.
어미의 identifies the mother whose heart is distressed; Chunseom refers to herself.
가슴을 is the object in the figurative expression 가슴을 태우다, meaning to cause anguish or anxious distress.
The direct rhetorical question reproaches her son for causing her anguish.
길동의 links Gildong to his resolve.
His resolve is contrasted with his mother's attempt to dissuade him.
Connects 바뀌다 to the negative auxiliary 않다.

Marks the lack of change as part of the past narrative.
Closes the narrative statement about his unchanged resolve.
Gildong presents his own intended course of action.
이곳을 marks the place he intends to leave.
Written -아 connects leaving this place to subsequently finding his own path; both belong to his stated intention.
제 contracts 저의, meaning 'my': Gildong refers humbly to his own path in life when speaking to his mother.
길을 is the object of 찾다, figuratively his own direction in life.
-으려 introduces the action Gildong intends to carry out.
The connective and auxiliary together state his intention to find his own path.
grammar_links.display_meaning_en: I intend to find [my own path]

grammar_links.context_en: Gildong states his intention in formal polite speech to his mother.
Shows respect toward his mother as the person asked to put her mind at ease.
Connects the idiomatic request to put her mind at ease with the request to watch his future life.
제가 is the subject of the embedded clause about how Gildong lives; 제 is the subject-marker form of humble 저.
앞으로 gives a temporal direction: from now on, rather than physical movement forward.
어떻게 asks about the manner of his future life within the embedded question.
-는지 embeds the question of how he lives as what his mother should watch.
지켜봐, contracted from 지켜보아, connects watching to the benefactive auxiliary.
Gildong asks his mother to watch how his life unfolds, presenting this as something she can do for him.
grammar_links.display_meaning_en: please watch [how I live] for me

grammar_links.context_en: Shows respect toward his mother as the person performing the requested action.
Completes the formal respectful request to watch his future course.
Returns to Gildong as the subject of the narration.
집안에서 marks the household as where he sensed danger.
느낀 modifies 위험: the danger he had already sensed.
위험을 marks the danger as what he described to his mother.
Marks his account of the danger as a past narrative event.
Ends the statement in the chapter's plain written narrative register.
께서 respectfully marks Minister Hong as the person who cherishes the other concubine.
-시- honors Minister Hong, the subject of cherishing.
아끼시는 describes the other concubine.
의 connects the concubine to her attitude.
Her attitude is what Gildong observes.
His observation provides the basis for his inference about her hostility.
그분 respectfully refers to Minister Hong, whose affection she fears losing.
His affection is what she fears losing.
The uncertain possibility of losing his affection causes her fear.
Her fear explains why she regards Gildong and his mother as enemies.
와 joins Gildong and his mother as the people she regards as enemies.
를 marks Gildong and his mother together as the object of 여기다.
처럼 compares her treatment of them to her treatment of enemies.
Gildong presents her hostility as an inference from her attitude.
grammar_links.display_meaning_en: she seems to regard us as enemies

The possibility of suffering misfortune is the content of Gildong's worry.
Gildong expresses his worry respectfully to his mother.

그러니 is the contracted 그러하니 reason connective of 그렇다, meaning 'since that is so; therefore'. Gildong treats the danger just described as the reason for asking his mother not to worry too much about his departure.
제가 is the subject-marked form of humble 저, identifying Gildong as the person leaving.
나가는 modifies 일, making his contemplated departure the matter under discussion.
His departure is the matter his mother is asked not to worry about excessively.
The complete request includes 너무: he asks her not to worry too much.
grammar_links.display_meaning_en: please do not worry too much

grammar_links.context_en: -지 links worrying to the prohibitive auxiliary 말다.
The honorific respects his mother as the person addressed.
The formal imperative makes the prohibition a respectful request.
의 identifies the words as those of Chunseom's son.
Her son's words are what Chunseom heard.
들은 describes Chunseom as having heard his words before the resulting sorrow.
도 adds Chunseom's distress to her son's distress.
Her sorrow is what she could not shake off.

beats.event_en: During King Sejong's reign, Minister Hong rises to high office and enjoys a reputation for loyalty and filial devotion. His son Hong Inhyeong is born to his wife Lady Yu, while Hong Gildong is born to the maid Chunseom.
beats.quote: 화셜 됴션국 셰종됴 시졀의 ᄒᆞᆫ ᄌᆡ샹이 이시니 셩은 홍이오 명은 뫼라. ᄃᆡᄃᆡ 명문거죡으로 쇼년 등과ᄒᆞ여 벼ᄉᆞᆯ이 니죠판셔의 니르ᄆᆡ, 물망이 됴야의 읏듬이오, 츙효 겸비ᄒᆞ기로 일홈이 일국의 진동ᄒᆞ더라. 일즉 두 아들을 두어시니, 일ᄌᆞᄂᆞᆫ 일홈이 인형이니 뎡실 뉴시 쇼ᄉᆡᆼ이오, 일ᄌᆞᄂᆞᆫ 일홈이 길동이니 시비 츈셤의 쇼ᄉᆡᆼ이라.

beats.event_en: Before Gildong's birth, Minister Hong dreams that a blue dragon rushes toward him amid thunder. Believing the dream foretells an outstanding child, he approaches Lady Yu affectionately.
beats.quote: 션시의 공이 길동을 나흘 ᄯᆡ의 일몽을 어드니, 문득 뇌졍벽녁이 진동ᄒᆞ며 쳥룡이 슈염을 거ᄉᆞ리고 공의게 향ᄒᆞ여 다라들거ᄂᆞᆯ, 놀나 ᄭᆡ다르니 일쟝츈몽이라. 심즁의 ᄃᆡ희ᄒᆞ여 ᄉᆡᆨ각ᄒᆞ되, ‘ᄂᆡ 이졔 룡몽을 어더시니 반ᄃᆞ시 귀ᄒᆞᆫ 자식을 나흐리라’ ᄒᆞ고 즉시 ᄂᆡ당으로 드러가니, 부인 뉴시 니러 맛거ᄂᆞᆯ, 공이 흔언이 그 옥슈를 니그러 졍이 친압고져 ᄒᆞ거ᄂᆞᆯ, 부인이 졍ᄉᆡᆨ 왈,

beats.event_en: Lady Yu refuses his advances, saying that such behavior is beneath his dignity.
beats.quote: “샹공이 쳬위 죤즁ᄒᆞ시거ᄂᆞᆯ, 년쇼 경박ᄌᆞ의 비루ᄒᆞ물 ᄒᆡᆼ코져 ᄒᆞ시니 쳡은 봉ᄒᆡᆼ치 아니ᄒᆞ리로쇼이다.”

beats.event_en: After Lady Yu pulls away, Minister Hong leaves embarrassed and angry. When Chunseom brings tea, he takes her into a side room and becomes intimate with her. He subsequently makes her his concubine; she gives birth to an extraordinary-looking boy. He rejoices but regrets that the child was not born to his wife.
beats.quote: ᄒᆞ고, 언파의 손을 ᄯᅥᆯ치고 나가거ᄂᆞᆯ, 공이 가쟝 무류ᄒᆞ여 분긔ᄅᆞᆯ ᄎᆞᆷ지 못ᄒᆞ고 외당의 나와 부인의 지식이 업스물 한탄ᄒᆞ더니, 맛ᄎᆞᆷ 시비 츈셤이 ᄎᆞᄅᆞᆯ 올니긔로 그 고요ᄒᆞ믈 인ᄒᆞ여 츈셤을 잇글고 협실의 드러가 졍이 친압ᄒᆞ니, 이 ᄯᆡ 츈셤의 나히 십팔이라. ᄒᆞᆫ 번 몸을 허ᄒᆞᆫ 후로 문외의 나지 아니ᄒᆞ고 타인을 ᄎᆔᄒᆞᆯ ᄯᅳᆺ이 업스니, 공이 긔특이 넉여 인ᄒᆞ여 잉쳡을 삼아더니, 과연 그 달붓허 ᄐᆡ긔 잇셔 십 삭만의 일ᄀᆡ 옥동을 ᄉᆡᆼᄒᆞ니, 긔골이 비범ᄒᆞ여 진짓 영웅 호걸의 긔상이라. 공이 일변 깃거ᄒᆞ나 부인의게 나지 못ᄒᆞ믈 한ᄒᆞ더라.

beats.event_en: Gildong displays exceptional intelligence by eight, increasing his father's affection. Nevertheless, because of his mother's low status, he is reprimanded whenever he calls his father 'father' or his brother 'brother.' Past ten, he still cannot use those addresses, and the servants' contempt leaves him deeply resentful. One autumn moonlit night, he pushes aside his reading desk and sighs.
beats.quote: 길동이 졈졈 ᄌᆞ라 팔 셰 되ᄆᆡ, 춍명이 과인ᄒᆞ여 ᄒᆞᆫ아흘 드르면 ᄇᆡᆨ을 통ᄒᆞ니 공이 더옥 ᄋᆡ즁ᄒᆞ나, 근본 쳔ᄉᆡᆼ이라 길동이 ᄆᆡ양 호부호형ᄒᆞ면 문득 ᄭᅮ지져 못ᄒᆞ계 ᄒᆞ니, 길동이 십 셰 넘도록 감히 부형을 부르지 못ᄒᆞ고, 비복 등이 쳔ᄃᆡᄒᆞ물 각골통한ᄒᆞ여 심ᄉᆞᄅᆞᆯ 졍치 못ᄒᆞ더니, 츄구월 망간을 당ᄒᆞᄆᆡ, 명월은 죠요ᄒᆞ고 쳥풍은 쇼슬ᄒᆞ여 사ᄅᆞᆷ의 심회ᄅᆞᆯ 돕ᄂᆞᆫ지라. 길동이 셔당의셔 글을 닑다가 문득 셔안을 밀치고 탄왈,

beats.event_en: Gildong longs to distinguish himself through scholarship or military achievement and leave an enduring name. Yet having a father and brother whom he cannot acknowledge with those familial addresses makes his isolation unbearable.
beats.quote: “대쟝뷔 셰샹의 나ᄆᆡ 공ᄆᆡᆼ을 본밧지 못ᄒᆞ면, 찰아리 병법을 외와 대쟝닌을 요하의 빗기 ᄎᆞ고 동졍셔벌ᄒᆞ여, 국가의 ᄃᆡ공을 셰우고 일홈을 만ᄃᆡ의 빗ᄂᆡ미 쟝부의 쾌ᄉᆡ라. 나ᄂᆞᆫ 엇지ᄒᆞ여 일신이 젹막ᄒᆞ고 부형이 이시되 호부호형을 못ᄒᆞ니 심쟝이 터질지라. 엇지 통한치 아니리오.”

beats.event_en: After expressing his anguish, Gildong goes into the courtyard to practice swordsmanship. Minister Hong, who is also enjoying the moonlight, notices him and calls him over.
beats.quote: ᄒᆞ고, 말을 맛츠며 ᄯᅳᆯ의 나려 검술을 공부ᄒᆞ더니, 맛ᄎᆞᆷ 공이 ᄯᅩᄒᆞᆫ 월ᄉᆡᆨ을 구경ᄒᆞ다가 길동의 ᄇᆡ회ᄒᆞ믈 보고 즉시 불너 문왈,

beats.event_en: Minister Hong asks why Gildong remains awake so late.
beats.quote: “네 무ᄉᆞᆷ 흥이 이셔 야심토록 잠을 ᄌᆞ지 아니ᄒᆞᄂᆞᆫ다?”

beats.event_en: Gildong respectfully says that although human beings are considered precious, he himself is denied that dignity.
beats.quote: “쇼인이 맛ᄎᆞᆷ 월ᄉᆡᆨ을 사랑ᄒᆞ미여니와, 대개 하ᄂᆞᆯ이 만물을 ᄂᆡ시ᄆᆡ 오직 사ᄅᆞᆷ이 귀ᄒᆞ오나, 쇼인의게 니ᄅᆞ러ᄂᆞᆫ 귀ᄒᆞ오미 업ᄉᆞ오니 엇지 사ᄅᆞᆷ이라 ᄒᆞ오리잇가.”

beats.event_en: Minister Hong understands what Gildong means but deliberately responds reproachfully.
beats.quote: 공이 그 말을 짐작ᄒᆞ나 짐즛 ᄎᆡᆨ왈,

beats.event_en: Minister Hong asks what Gildong means by his words.
beats.quote: “네 무ᄉᆞᆷ 말인고.”

beats.event_en: Gildong explains that he is grateful to the parents who gave him life and raised him, but his lifelong sorrow is being unable to call his own father 'father' and his own brother 'brother.'
beats.quote: “쇼인이 평ᄉᆡᆼ 셜운 바ᄂᆞᆫ, 대감 졍긔로 당당ᄒᆞ온 남ᄌᆡ 되여ᄉᆞ오니 부ᄉᆡᆼ모휵지은이 깁ᄉᆞᆸ거ᄂᆞᆯ, 그 부친을 부친이라 못ᄒᆞ옵고, 그 형을 형이라 못ᄒᆞ오니 엇지 사ᄅᆞᆷ이라 ᄒᆞ오리잇가.”

beats.event_en: Gildong weeps. Minister Hong feels pity but fears that comforting him would encourage presumptuous behavior, so he rebukes him harshly.
beats.quote: ᄒᆞ고, 눈물을 흘여 단삼을 젹시거ᄂᆞᆯ, 공니 쳥파의 비록 측은ᄒᆞ나 만일 그 ᄯᅳᆺ을 위로ᄒᆞ면 ᄆᆞᄅᆞᆷ이 방ᄌᆞᄒᆞᆯ가 져어 크게 ᄭᅮ지져 왈,

beats.event_en: Minister Hong says Gildong is not the only son of a low-status maid in a minister's household and threatens to banish him from his presence if he raises the matter again.
beats.quote: “ᄌᆡ샹가 쳔비 쇼ᄉᆡᆼ이 비단 너ᄲᅮᆫ이 아니거든, 네 엇지 방ᄌᆞᄒᆞ미 이 ᄀᆞᆺ흐뇨. ᄎᆞ후 다시 이런 말이 이시면 안젼의 용납지 못ᄒᆞ리라.”

beats.event_en: Unable to answer, Gildong remains bowed down in tears. At his father's command, he returns to his room and continues grieving.
beats.quote: ᄒᆞ니, 길동이 감이 일언을 고치 못ᄒᆞ고 다만 복지유쳬 ᄲᅮᆫ이라. 공이 명ᄒᆞ여 물너가라 하거ᄂᆞᆯ, 길동이 침쇼로 도라와 슬허ᄒᆞ믈 마지 아이ᄒᆞ더라.

beats.event_en: Gifted and broad-minded by nature, Gildong cannot settle his feelings or sleep at night. One day he visits his mother and speaks to her in tears.
beats.quote: 길동이 본ᄃᆡ ᄌᆡ긔 과인ᄒᆞ고 도량이 활달ᄒᆞᆫ지라. 마음을 진졍치 못ᄒᆞ여 밤이면 ᄌᆞᆷ을 닐우지 못ᄒᆞ더니, 일일은 길동이 어미 침쇼의 가 울며 고왈,

beats.event_en: Gildong expresses profound gratitude to his mother but says he cannot endure the contempt attached to his low status. He intends to leave her care and asks her not to worry about him and to look after her health.
beats.quote: “쇼ᄌᆡ 모친으로 더부러 젼ᄉᆡᆼ 년분이 즁ᄒᆞ여 금셰의 모ᄌᆡ 되오니 은혜 망극ᄒᆞ온지라. 그러나 쇼ᄌᆡ의 팔ᄌᆡ 긔박ᄒᆞ여 쳔ᄒᆞᆫ 몸이 되오니 품은 한이 깁ᄉᆞ온지라. 쟝뷔 셰상의 쳐ᄒᆞᄆᆡ 남의 쳔ᄃᆡ 바드미 불가ᄒᆞ온지라. 쇼ᄌᆡ ᄌᆞ연 긔운을 억졔치 못ᄒᆞ여 모친 슬하를 ᄯᅥ나려 ᄒᆞ오니, 복망 모친은 쇼ᄌᆞ를 념녀치 마르시고 귀쳬를 보즁ᄒᆞ쇼셔.”

beats.event_en: His mother protests that he is not alone in his circumstances and asks why he would break her heart by thinking this way.
beats.quote: “ᄌᆡ샹가 쳔ᄉᆡᆼ이 너ᄲᅮᆫ이 아니여든 엇지 협ᄒᆞᆫ 마음을 발ᄒᆞ여 어미 간쟝을 ᄉᆞ로난요.”

beats.event_en: Gildong maintains his resolve to leave and asks his mother to await his future. He warns that Minister Hong's favored concubine regards them both as enemies out of fear of losing his affection, and he worries that they may suffer grave harm.
beats.quote: “녯날 장츙의 ᄋᆞ들 길산은 쳔ᄉᆡᆼ이로되 십삼 셰의 그 어미를 니별ᄒᆞ고 운봉산의 드러가 도를 닷가 아롬다온 일흠을 후셰의 유젼ᄒᆞ여시니, 쇼ᄌᆡ 그를 효측ᄒᆞ여 셰샹을 버셔나려ᄒᆞ오니, 모친은 안심허샤 후일을 기다리쇼셔. 건간 곡산모의 ᄒᆡᆼᄉᆡᆨ을 보니 샹공의 춍을 닐흘가 ᄒᆞ여 우리 모ᄌᆞ를 원슈갓치 아ᄂᆞᆫ지라. 큰 화을 닙을가 ᄒᆞ옵ᄂᆞ니 모친은 쇼ᄌᆞ 나가믈 념여치 마르쇼셔.”

beats.event_en: His mother remains sorrowful after hearing him.
beats.quote: ᄒᆞ니, 그 어미 ᄯᅩᄒᆞᆫ 슬허ᄒᆞ더라.

entries.role_en: Minister Hong, father of Hong Inhyeong and Hong Gildong; husband of Lady Yu. His affection for Gildong conflicts with his enforcement of social distinctions.
Son of Minister Hong and Chunseom, and younger half-brother of Hong Inhyeong. His abilities and ambitions clash with restrictions on acknowledging his father and brother.
Son of Minister Hong and his wife Lady Yu; Gildong's older half-brother, whom Gildong is forbidden to address as brother.
Minister Hong's wife and Hong Inhyeong's mother, distinct from Gildong's mother Chunseom. She rejects her husband's advances following his dragon dream.
Gildong's mother, formerly a maid in Minister Hong's household and subsequently his concubine. Gildong tells her of his intention to leave.
The king whose reign provides the opening's historical setting; he does not participate in this chapter's family conflict.

The sole essential story-term exemption: inherited social standing explains why Gildong, born to a low-status maid who becomes a concubine, cannot address his father and older half-brother by their familial titles despite his father's affection. This restriction drives his anguish and intention to leave. Other historical roles and secondary details receive ordinary vocabulary review or simpler wording.

adaptation_decisions.scope_reason_en: Cover the contiguous opening through paragraph 23: the family's unequal relationships, the auspicious dream and Gildong's birth, his exceptional ability and frustrated ambitions, his unsuccessful appeal to his father, and his announcement to his mother that he intends to leave. TOPIK 5 permits these developments to remain full scenes, with dialogue and the source-supported tension between paternal affection and enforcement of status distinctions. Refer to the father as Minister Hong, following the reviewed placeholder note, and distinguish his wife Lady Yu, her son Hong Inhyeong, and Gildong's mother Chunseom. Retain the dream and birth because they establish the contrast between anticipated greatness and restricted social standing. Simplify ceremonial gestures, intimate description, ornamental scenery and classical wording; omit the named Gilsan precedent in paragraph 22 while preserving Gildong's resolve and his warning about the favored concubine. These omissions reduce incidental historical explanation without removing the scene's causes or emotional development. The remaining narrative proceeds into the concubine's conspiracy, attempted assassination, departure, outlaw leadership and later political and overseas arcs. Those developments could be told naturally at this level, but constitute subsequent narrative movements rather than necessary extensions of this opening chapter. Paragraph 23 closes the mother-son exchange in sorrow, after Gildong has expressed his intention but before he actually leaves. Stop there, immediately before paragraph 24 begins the narrator's account of Chonan and her plot; the next chapter starts at paragraph 24. No fixed paragraph or adaptation-length quota governs this choice.
adaptation_decisions.length_reason_en: The chapter retains the planned opening through source paragraph 23 as developed scenes: the distinct family relationships, dragon dream and birth, Gildong's abilities and denied familial addresses, his ambitions, the failed appeal to his father, and his announcement to his mother. Connected modern written narration and sustained dialogue preserve the source-supported conflict between paternal affection and enforcement of inherited status, suitable for TOPIK 5. Ceremonial detail, explicit intimate description, ornamental scenery, classical allusions and the named Gilsan precedent are reduced or omitted without removing the main causal and emotional development. More meaningful narrative could be adapted at this level, but paragraph 24 begins a separate movement concerning the concubine's conspiracy. Ending with the mother's sorrow completes this exchange while preserving the distinction between Gildong's intention to leave and his later departure. Length follows that narrative coverage and coherent boundary, without a numerical quota.

bindings.level_reason_en: The complete chapter is suitable for Level 5. Varied narrative connectives, inferred motives, rhetorical questions and precise emotional vocabulary serve the story without sustained dense embedding. The two Level 6 proposition modifiers occur in clear reason frames and add limited complexity beyond the target. Unlisted grammar includes several different functions, but its most frequent forms express familiar manner, emotion, intention and direct questioning; repetition reduces the learning burden. Understanding does depend on these constructions, especially in Gildong's appeals and the father's feared consequence, so selective help should explain their complete meanings. These demanding passages remain bounded by straightforward narration and explicit relationships. Level 6 and unlisted ordinary vocabulary together account for approximately 7.25% of occurrences, within the existing budget; contextual glosses support the historical and emotional terms. The combined frequency, variety and complexity of exceptions do not overwhelm the cumulative Level 5 core.

bindings.analysis_en: The source explicitly includes -(으)ㄹ 수 없다 as the negative counterpart expressing inability or impossibility.
Expresses ability or possibility, including the possibility challenged by Gildong's rhetorical questions.
에서 marks the setting where an action occurs, including acting in someone's presence.
The descriptive variant -은 데다가 adds anger to embarrassment; the source explicitly includes this modifier variant.
Dependent noun 외, meaning outside or beyond the preceding category, combines with 에. Here 외에 means 'in addition to Lady Yu', retaining the existing partner while adding another.
도 adds a participant or item and can emphasize an unexpected inclusion as 'even'.
-ㄹ뿐더러 adds broad-mindedness to outstanding talent. Its ㄹ does not independently express future time.

향해 and 위해 make the lexical predicates 향하다 and 위하다 describe the direction or beneficiary of another action. The catalog does not explicitly establish this adverbial -아/어 function; the reason/sequence row does not prove equivalence.
bindings.optional_reason_en: These two familiar adverbial forms specify direction and beneficiary. Their lexical meanings and contextual glosses support comprehension without introducing a complex new clause relation at Level 5.

bindings.analysis_en: These occurrences use -게 to express manner or degree. The catalog's -게2 denotes purpose and therefore does not establish the function used here.
bindings.optional_reason_en: The nine occurrences repeatedly express manner or degree, including familiar 이렇게, 그렇게 and 어떻게. This consistent, local transformation supports Level 5 narration without adding unfamiliar clause structures.

bindings.analysis_en: -었- combines with adverse conditional -다가는 in 주었다가는. The complete form supposes that comfort is offered and warns of a feared consequence; it does not assert a past act of comforting.
The source explicitly lists -ㄴ 뒤 without 에. 합격한 뒤 places advancement after completed examination success.
-거나 joins calling his father and calling his brother as alternative occasions triggering a scolding.
The source covers both prospective -ㄹ 듯하다 and present -는 듯하다: an impression of future greatness and an inference about the concubine's hostility.
터질 것만 같다 expresses an intensified impression of impending bursting. The catalog lists -ㄹ 것 같다 but does not explicitly cover emphatic 만 here; its exclusive 만 row would misrepresent this function.
bindings.optional_reason_en: This single intensified comparison conveys overwhelming anguish through a familiar 것 같다 frame. The complete phrase gloss explains its emotional force, making it manageable for Level 5 without treating 만 as literal exclusivity.

bindings.analysis_en: 에 marks the position reached with 오르다: advancement to a high official post. This is an abstract destination complement.
In 이루고 싶다, -고 is the connector explicitly required by the listed desire construction -고 싶다. It links the action to 싶다 rather than coordinating independent actions.
이/가 marks the noun complement of 되다: the role or identity attained, rather than the person becoming it.
The source explicitly includes -기 전 without 에, matching 태어나기 전.
The proposition-modifying 줄 construction expresses a supposed fact with 알다. 너뿐인 줄 concerns believing that one is the only person, rather than knowing how to perform an action.
Matches actions performed for another person, including raising, soothing, changing something for someone, and the request to watch.
The source explicitly includes standalone -아/-어 as related forms of the reason connective. These occurrences connect a cause or grounds to its consequence.
에 marks the emotional cause in 반가운 마음에: his gladness motivates the following actions.
The particle marks grounds or cause in 이유로 and 이 일로, rather than a direction of movement.
Matches the role or capacity marked by (으)로 with being known, taking someone as a concubine, and relationships such as son or mother and son.

The source includes descriptive and completed-action modifiers before 것. Here the construction packages the quiet surroundings and the negative birth proposition as facts evaluated by the following verb.
와 marks the comparison partner of 같다 in 너와 같은 처지: a situation like yours.
Combines simultaneous -면서 with emphatic 도: even while delighted, he also felt regret. Both components are required; the concession arises from the contrasting simultaneous states.
Directly matches 있는데도, contrasting having a father and brother with being unable to address them by their familial titles.

그럼에도 means nevertheless or despite that situation. The catalog lists 에도 불구하고, but does not explicitly cover the standalone concessive noun + 에도 construction; ordinary locative 에 and additive 도 do not establish an equivalent concession function.
bindings.optional_reason_en: The single occurrence links the father's understanding to his deliberate pretense. This common discourse connector supports the source-based contrast in motivation and presents manageable additional difficulty for Level 5.

bindings.analysis_en: Matches both the recurring condition 들으면 and the threatened condition 하면; neither requires a different conditional identity.
겠 expresses an inference about obtaining a child and imagined fulfillment in a hypothetical future, distinct from the speaker's intention.

The dependent -아/어 linker is explicitly covered within all auxiliary constructions used by this identity here: benefactive 주다, resultative 놓다, and continuing result-state 있다. It does not independently mean sequence or cause.
Supplies Gildong's inability as background for his rhetorical question.
Coordinates actions or descriptions; the final predicate can establish their shared narrative time.
Contrasts Gildong's return to his room with his continuing sorrow.
Expresses coordination or simultaneous actions, including crying while speaking.
Nominalizing -기 combines with 는커녕 to reject the expected reaction: far from feeling afraid, he was delighted. Both the nominalizer and the contrary-expectation particle are supplied.
Identifies a person, relationship, age, or experience through a nominal predicate.
The copula takes the present adnominal -ㄴ form to identify or classify the following noun; 인 does not mark a completed action.
The catalog explicitly includes -을 만큼. Here it measures intelligence by the extent of what Gildong could understand.
The catalog lacks the general adjective + -아/어 하다 construction expressing an emotional response. Its specific -고 싶어 하다 entry does not establish coverage for 두려워하다, 기뻐하다, or 아쉬워하다.
bindings.optional_reason_en: Four occurrences express fear, delight, and regret through a common emotional-response construction. These transparent predicates support the characters' motivations without adding complex clause structure; selective form help is appropriate for Level 5.

bindings.analysis_en: Expresses Gildong's own desire to achieve his ambition.

The nominalizer -기 presents an activity for evaluation by 어렵다, meaning that doing it is difficult. Both grammatical formation and lexical predicate are supplied; the catalog's -기가 쉽다 is not substituted for this meaning.
Marks the direction or destination of movement, including rooms and the courtyard.
보니 introduces a realization or inference arising from observation. The supplied -으니 entry explicitly covers reason, which does not establish this discovery function.
bindings.optional_reason_en: Two short 보니 clauses connect observation to realization or inference. This common narrative use is accessible at Level 5 with contextual help distinguishing discovery from a reason connective.

bindings.analysis_en: Marks every occasion or recurring time, including each incident and every night.

Retrospective -던 modifies dependent 중 in its listed ongoing-activity sense: while he was complaining. This composition preserves the retrospective modifier rather than substituting the catalog's distinct -는 중이다 formation.
Embeds what Gildong intends to say and how he lives as the content understood or watched.
조차 emphasizes unexpected inclusion: even household workers, and even in front of his family.
에 marks the examination in which a passing result is achieved with 합격하다.
만 restricts Gildong's response to tears alone.
The particle 뿐 follows 너 and means 'you alone'; it is distinct from the dependent-noun construction after a verb modifier.
맺은 것이다 explains the preceding decision through an explanatory nominal predicate. The catalog lists clause nominalization and 이다 separately but does not explicitly list this explanatory construction.
bindings.optional_reason_en: This single explanatory restatement clarifies what taking Chunseom as a concubine meant. Its completed-action nominal clause and copula are familiar prerequisites for Level 5; the contextual explanatory function adds limited difficulty.

bindings.analysis_en: The formal imperative supplies respectful requests to Gildong's mother, including the command ending on a prohibition.
The formal polite question ending appears in Lady Yu's challenge and Gildong's respectful rhetorical questions.
The catalog explicitly includes -곤 하다. 못하곤 했다 describes recurring inability to sleep in the past.
계신 combines the listed honorific locative verb 계시다 with its present-state noun modifier -ㄴ. It means 'who holds that position', rather than a completed action.
께서 respectfully marks Minister Hong as the subject of cherishing the other concubine.
까지 means emphatic inclusion, 'even', with anger and social status. The endpoint function of Level 1 까지 is not the relevant match.
The quotation row explicitly includes -으라고 and -라고. 물러가라고 reports the father's order to leave.
The quotation function covers declarative propositions supplied to predicates of thinking or saying; the identical reason-giving connective is a different function.
The intention connective explicitly includes -으려 and -려, used here before auxiliary 하다.

The complete -으려 하다 construction expresses an intention or attempt without asserting success. The catalog lists the intention connective but does not explicitly cover its combination with auxiliary 하다; lexical 하다 'do' alone does not establish that auxiliary function.
bindings.optional_reason_en: Three occurrences express a concrete attempt or stated departure plans. The repeated construction has a transparent intended-action clause and familiar auxiliary inflections, providing manageable support for motivations at Level 5.

bindings.analysis_en: -겠- expresses the speaker's resolve in Lady Yu's refusal, Gildong's ambition and the father's threat.

말하려는 modifies the intended action within 말하려는지: what Gildong was trying to say. The catalog lists the intention connective -(으)려 but does not explicitly cover this intention modifier; the connective alone does not establish coverage of the complete formation.
bindings.optional_reason_en: This single intention modifier precisely distinguishes Gildong's intended message from words actually spoken. Its combination with an embedded question is suitable for selective help at Level 5.

bindings.analysis_en: 있겠는가 uses the interrogative -는가 in a reflective rhetorical question about imagined fulfillment. This matches the question function, rather than the separately cataloged problem-posing function.
에 marks a spatial or figurative location in 입에, 세상에, 내 앞에 and 마음속에. The idiomatic meanings of the surrounding expressions remain lexical matters.
In 나라에 충성하다, 에 marks the entity toward which loyalty is directed. The catalog's particle entry has no restriction to time or physical location.
대꾸하지 못한 채 describes prostrating himself and crying while remaining unable to answer back. 채 is the same maintained-state construction as cataloged 채로, with 로 omitted.
나무라듯 describes asking in a manner resembling scolding. -듯 is the shortened form of the cataloged manner connective -듯이.
큰 소리로 marks the manner of scolding: in a loud voice. This is a use of the cataloged particle (으)로.
학문으로 identifies scholarly learning as the means of achieving an ambition, matching the instrumental use of (으)로.

이끄는 법 and 칼 쓰는 법 identify how to perform an action. The supplied vocabulary candidate 법 refers to law, while -는 법이다 expresses a general rule; neither honestly covers this dependent-noun method construction.
bindings.optional_reason_en: The two transparent method phrases identify learning to lead troops and practicing sword technique. They support faithful storytelling with modest grammatical difficulty for Level 5; catalog absence does not make them advanced.

bindings.analysis_en: In 할 수 있겠습니까, -겠- frames possibility hypothetically within respectful rhetorical questions. The cataloged prefinal ending is not restricted to intention.

Descriptive predicates take -(으)ㄴ to modify nouns, as in 젊은 나이 and 높은 벼슬. This matches the present descriptive modifier explicitly included among the source entry's related forms, rather than the completed-action modifier.
살아야 하니 expresses having to live under these circumstances. The source explicitly includes -아야 하다 as a synonymous necessity construction.

살아야 is the linking form inside 살아야 하다, whose auxiliary supplies necessity. It is covered by that explicit construction; the separate conditional -어야 entry would not establish this auxiliary-linking function.
-지 links predicates to 않다, 못하다 or 말다 in this chapter. These three cataloged constructions explicitly cover the linking component; the contrastive -지 entry has a different function.
Matches predicate negation with -지 않다, including negative modifiers and questions. Question context can invite agreement without changing the negative construction's identity.
Matches inability expressed by -지 못하다, including inability imposed by social restrictions and circumstances rather than lack of skill.
Matches nominalizing -음/-ㅁ in 업신여김 and contracted 그럼 (그러함).
Matches -기 turning an action or state into a nominal expression.
Matches action nominalization with -는 것, including contemplated appearing and living one's life.
Matches 와/과 coordinating nouns, including father and brother or mother and son.
The catalog does not list derivational -답다. In 사람답게 it expresses a quality befitting a human being, contextually living with human dignity; no listed simpler construction covers this derivation.
bindings.optional_reason_en: Occurs once in Gildong's appeal for human dignity. Its meaning matters to the rhetorical question, but the familiar base 사람 and the surrounding account of denied familial recognition support comprehension with selective help at Level 5.

bindings.analysis_en: Matches the object particle 을/를.
Matches -더니 recalling observed thunder followed by the dragon's charge; this is not the separately listed -었더니 construction.
Matches -(으)ㄹ 때 identifying an occasion. In 부를 때마다, 마다 separately makes the occasions recurring.
Matches completed-action -(으)ㄴ modifiers, including completed births and acts of care, distinct from descriptive present modifiers.
Matches -았/었/였-. In 주었다가는 it is a component of a hypothetical construction and does not independently assert an actual past act.
Matches 에게 marking a personal source with 받다: 남에게 identifies the people from whom contemptuous treatment is received. The catalog's particle row has no recipient-only restriction.
Matches 에게서 marking a personal source, here the mother to whom a son was born.
Matches plain declarative -는다/-ㄴ다/-다 in narration and quoted statements.
The catalog does not list direct-question -냐/-느냐/-(으)냐. Quoted -느냐고 and direct -니 are distinct forms and cannot supply this binding.
bindings.optional_reason_en: Six direct questions establish familiar or stern parent-to-child speech. The recurring ending carries essential questioning force but introduces one consistent register feature, supported by interrogative words and clear dialogue context at Level 5.

bindings.analysis_en: The catalog has no entry for plural 들. In 사람들조차 it explicitly pluralizes the household workers; 조차 is a separate particle.
bindings.optional_reason_en: Occurs once on familiar 사람 to identify a group. This common, transparent plural marker adds little processing difficulty at Level 5 despite its catalog absence.

bindings.analysis_en: Matches formal polite declarative -습니다/-ㅂ니다 in Gildong's respectful speech and Lady Yu's refusal.
에 marks an occupied position or condition in 지위에 계신 and 처지에 있는.
의 marks possession or relationship, including the contracted possessives 제 and 내.
에게 identifies the person who has something with 있다: 그에게는 and 제게는. This is a use of the listed personal particle.
The current action modifier describes ongoing or habitual actions relative to narrative time, including locative 있는.
모르는 척하다 expresses pretending not to know, matching the catalog's pretense construction.
-지 말다 prohibits worrying; honorific and command endings retain this prohibitive function.
The -(으)ㄹ modifier introduces contemplated or possible actions before nouns such as 수, 때 and 만큼; it need not assert future time.
나라를 위해 identifies whose interests the action serves. The catalog explicitly includes 을 위해 and 를 위해.
Quotes familial titles or a descriptive designation. The catalog explicitly includes shortened 라 and 이라 alongside (이)라고.
-구나 and -는구나 express Minister Hong's delighted inference and Gildong's painful recognition.
-아/어서 gives the cause of the following action: surprise before opening his eyes and anger before coming outside.
The reason connective -으니/-니 introduces grounds for an inference, ambition, distress or request, including contracted 그러니.
있기에 asks what circumstance explains Gildong's remaining awake, matching causal -기에.
부모에게 marks the people toward whom filial devotion is directed.
귀하다고 하다 reports the assertion that people are precious. The source's quotation function explicitly includes -다고; the negative question requests confirmation.
일꾼이었다는 and 낮다는 make propositions modify 이유. They match the catalog's -는다는 construction and its related -다는 form, without requiring an actual quoted speaker.
bindings.optional_reason_en: These two Level 6 modifiers precisely state the social grounds for Gildong's exclusion. Both occur in the transparent frame ‘the reason that …’, with familiar predicates and no extended quotation nesting. Their local complexity is manageable for Level 5 with selective help; whole-chapter review must still assess their combined burden with other exceptions.

bindings.analysis_en: 나와 있었습니다 describes remaining outside after coming out, matching the continuing result-state construction.
밀쳐 놓고 presents the desk as left displaced after being pushed aside, matching -어 놓다.
Recalls earlier ongoing or habitual activities, including working, reading, and complaining.
The catalog explicitly includes standalone -아/어 related forms. These occurrences connect closely successive actions, with time supplied by the main predicate.
넘어서도 places the continuing restriction after passing the age threshold; this is the sequential use of -아/어서.
The catalog includes connective -자 as a related form of -자마자. 맞이하자 and 명하자 introduce the immediate occasion for the following action.
처럼 compares behavior or treatment to that of a young person or enemies.
-면서 presents growth alongside developing talent and delight alongside another feeling. The added concession in -면서도 has a separate identity.
집안에서 identifies the household of origin in the birth clause, matching the source use of 에서.
부터 marks a temporal starting point in 그달부터 and the starting aspect of an assessment in 생김새부터.
-시- honors the subject performing the action, including parents and respectfully addressed listeners.
이/가 marks clause subjects, including contracted subject-marked pronouns.
위로하는 대신 contrasts comforting with the scolding chosen instead. Omission of 에 preserves the listed construction's substitution function.
어렵다면 and 남긴다면 introduce hypothetical conditions, matching the catalog's conditional -다면 and -ㄴ다면 forms.
로 gives temporal direction or extension in 그 뒤로 and 앞으로: from then onward and into the future.
밤이 깊도록 sets the temporal limit of remaining awake: until late into the night. The listed -도록 covers this extent or limit function.
The uncertain-question ending identifies a feared possibility before 두렵다 or 걱정되다; it retains its interrogative function in these embedded uses.
에 marks the time or age at which a state or event holds.
은/는 marks narrative topics and contextual contrasts, including contrastive attachment after other particles or a nominalized predicate.
이러다가는 warns that continuation of the present situation could produce an adverse consequence, matching -다가는.
와/과 marks another participant in marrying or establishing a relationship.
가을밤 is a transparent noun compound of 가을, autumn, and 밤, night: an autumn night. Both lexical prerequisites are supplied; no additional grammatical construction is required.
공손히 means respectfully or politely. Neither this adverb nor the required derivational prerequisites are supplied in the curriculum candidates.

Reviewed lexical evidence establishes the interpersonal sense of 가까이하다 here. The catalog supplies 가까이 and 하다 separately, but their presence does not establish this lexicalized verb's sense or a complete productive derivation.
꾸지람 denotes a scolding. No matching noun or complete productive formation is supplied.
대꾸하다 is the action verb formed from 대꾸, a reply or answering back, and verbalizing 하다. Here it means answer back to the father; both lexical prerequisites are supplied.
명하다 means command in 물러가라고 명하자. No equivalent commanding verb or complete derivational prerequisites are supplied.
모자 meaning mother and son matches 모자01, illustrated by 모자가 닮다. It is distinct from 모자02 meaning a hat.
밀치다 means push hard or shove, here pushing the desk aside. No matching verb or complete productive prerequisites are supplied; 치다 alone cannot establish this formation.
원한 denotes a deep grudge or resentment arising from injustice. The supplied 원수 and 한 entries are different lexical identities and do not cover this noun.

Verb meaning to spend time or live in a particular manner, here describing Chunseom's subsequent life.

optional_grammar_reasons.adverbial-connective-a-eo: These two familiar adverbial forms specify direction and beneficiary. Their lexical meanings and contextual glosses support comprehension without introducing a complex new clause relation at Level 5.
optional_grammar_reasons.adverbial-ge: The nine occurrences repeatedly express manner or degree, including familiar 이렇게, 그렇게 and 어떻게. This consistent, local transformation supports Level 5 narration without adding unfamiliar clause structures.
optional_grammar_reasons.appearance-geot-man-gatda: This single intensified comparison conveys overwhelming anguish through a familiar 것 같다 frame. The complete phrase gloss explains its emotional force, making it manageable for Level 5 without treating 만 as literal exclusivity.
optional_grammar_reasons.concessive-noun-edo: The single occurrence links the father's understanding to his deliberate pretense. This common discourse connector supports the source-based contrast in motivation and presents manageable additional difficulty for Level 5.
optional_grammar_reasons.descriptive-a-eo-hada: Four occurrences express fear, delight, and regret through a common emotional-response construction. These transparent predicates support the characters' motivations without adding complex clause structure; selective form help is appropriate for Level 5.
optional_grammar_reasons.discovery-euni: Two short 보니 clauses connect observation to realization or inference. This common narrative use is accessible at Level 5 with contextual help distinguishing discovery from a reason connective.
optional_grammar_reasons.explanatory-eun-neun-geot-ida: This single explanatory restatement clarifies what taking Chunseom as a concubine meant. Its completed-action nominal clause and copula are familiar prerequisites for Level 5; the contextual explanatory function adds limited difficulty.
optional_grammar_reasons.intention-euryeo-hada: Three occurrences express a concrete attempt or stated departure plans. The repeated construction has a transparent intended-action clause and familiar auxiliary inflections, providing manageable support for motivations at Level 5.
optional_grammar_reasons.intention-modifier-euryeoneun: This single intention modifier precisely distinguishes Gildong's intended message from words actually spoken. Its combination with an embedded question is suitable for selective help at Level 5.
optional_grammar_reasons.method-neun-beop: The two transparent method phrases identify learning to lead troops and practicing sword technique. They support faithful storytelling with modest grammatical difficulty for Level 5; catalog absence does not make them advanced.
optional_grammar_reasons.noun-quality-dapda: Occurs once in Gildong's appeal for human dignity. Its meaning matters to the rhetorical question, but the familiar base 사람 and the surrounding account of denied familial recognition support comprehension with selective help at Level 5.
optional_grammar_reasons.plain-question-nya: Six direct questions establish familiar or stern parent-to-child speech. The recurring ending carries essential questioning force but introduces one consistent register feature, supported by interrogative words and clear dialogue context at Level 5.
optional_grammar_reasons.plural-deul: Occurs once on familiar 사람 to identify a group. This common, transparent plural marker adds little processing difficulty at Level 5 despite its catalog absence.
optional_grammar_reasons.reported-statement-modifier-daneun: These two Level 6 modifiers precisely state the social grounds for Gildong's exclusion. Both occur in the transparent frame ‘the reason that …’, with familiar predicates and no extended quotation nesting. Their local complexity is manageable for Level 5 with selective help; whole-chapter review must still assess their combined burden with other exceptions.
